senses.gloss: (= יְהֵא בָא) י׳ כ־ (= ch. אתיא כ־, v. אֲתָא) it agrees with, corresponds to.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:4:3">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ</cite> top <he>י׳ כיי דמר ר׳ וכ׳</he> it agrees with what R. Z. said. Ib. XVI, 15ᶜ bot. <he>יי׳ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:3:5">Y. Erub. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> top <he>יי׳ כי וכ׳</he> (read <cite ref="K00518"><he>כיי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:9">Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ</cite> top [read:] <he>יי׳ כהדא דתני כ׳ זכריה</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:31">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>יֵיבָה כיי דר׳ זעירא</he> ed. Lehm. (oth. ed. <he>יְהֵא בָא כיי דמר וכ׳</he>, ed. Krot. <he>יהא בה</he>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 2:6:2">Y. B. Kam. II, end, 3ᵃ</cite> <he>יי׳ בתפלוגתה וכ׳</he> it enters into (depends upon) the difference of opinions between &c.; ib. IV, 4ᵇ top <he>יי׳ כפלוגתא</he> (read: <he>בפ׳</he>).
